Based on my review of this NVIDIA technical blog post, **there is no discussion of context compaction, summarization, context management, or memory strategies for long-running agents**.

The article mentions that agents face token count growth ("token counts to grow quickly") and acknowledges the problem of accumulating history in multi-turn workflows, but it does not describe any specific compaction or summarization techniques to address this.

Regarding context length, the only relevant quote is:

"Long Context Ruler @1M **95%**"

This indicates the model supports 1M token context length, but the article does not explain how long agent sessions are actually handled or managed within this window.
